# Acquiring and cancelling the hidden response of physical operations

29 October 2026. Astra P1 root construction. This changes the actual execution
interface by compiling available operations into fresh randomized calls. It
does not assert that fitting a model makes original operations memoryless.

## 1. Question and consequence

Can acquired information remove hidden memory's influence on useful controlled
observations, rather than only predict it with a growing model or wait for
microscopic equilibration?

Chronological experiments acquire the relative directions of different controls'
hidden responses. A convex optimization finds a physical mixture cancelling
those directions, subject to useful-transition requirements. A measured
separating direction can instead exclude every allowed mixture. Exact population
cancellation gives a positive finite-state controlled process at all observation
depths, including feedback and retained old records. Strong lumpability,
covariance, convex separation and randomization are established. The candidate
addition is the physical acquisition/synthesis bridge. Historical originality,
an apparatus and practical advantage are not established.

The explicit source below has frozen continuous hidden memory. Each raw
operation has infinite observable linear rank; two compiled calls have an
exact two-state realization. Complete isolated-operation path laws cannot
determine whether cancellation is possible. A second source has identical
individual-operation laws but admits no cancelling mixture. Cross experiments
distinguish them.

## 2. Actual acquisition interface

Let X be a standard Borel hidden state, Y:X->{1,...,k} a finite noninvasive
visible label, and mu a warranted baseline calibration law. Put mu_a=mu(Y=a)>0.
Actual fixed calls T_1,...,T_s are reversible Markov kernels for mu in the main
version. Independent source preparations at mu, switching, specified durations
and fresh native randomness are actual premises.

Define

    K_j(a,b)=E_mu[f_jb |Y=a],
    r_jab=1_a(f_jb-K_j(a,b)),

H^a is PSD. Individual-outcome Grams H^{a,b} omit the sum over b. These are

# Final receiving addendum: clarification and finite-word exclusion

29 October 2026. Actual focused continuation of the independent receiving
review. This addendum reviews the changes to the root document, not a new
external audit or a physical validation.

Reviewed final input:

    ACQUIRED_HIDDEN_RESPONSE_CANCELLATION.md
    sha256 c4d9c883fe9fd4eefac93d726e78483519d3d129eb43f4e1d16b7ff087a1d24c
    18419 bytes

The exact reviewed bytes are retained in
reviewed_versions/ACQUIRED_HIDDEN_RESPONSE_CANCELLATION_c4d9c883fe9f.md.
The prior full review and exact independent checks remain valid for their
earlier saved source version; this addendum assesses the specific changes.

## Verdict

**Accept the final scoped mathematical construction.** The root adopted the
two requested clarifications. The new Section 10 finite-word exclusion and
the conditional approximate comparator are correct. No further mathematical
correction is requested at this reviewed scope. This conclusion does not
establish historical novelty, an apparatus, favorable acquisition cost or
practical advantage.

## 1. Adopted clarifications

The injectivity boundary now explicitly requires injective self-adjoint
operators that are positive semidefinite in a common L2 geometry. For any
nonzero f, an injective PSD operator has <f,Tf> > 0, since zero would imply
T^(1/2)f=0 and then Tf=0. A positive convex mixture therefore also has a
strictly positive quadratic form on every nonzero f and is injective. The
previous transition-entry ambiguity is removed.

The finite nullspace basis now supplies a common exceptional mu-null set for
all zero-defect simplex configurations, including a continuum of candidates.
This is the correct way to avoid an uncountable union of null sets. It retains
the proof for arbitrary old records with only unconditional initial absolute
continuity.

The added configuration-selection qualification in Section 6 is also
appropriate: a deployment hidden-density ceiling must hold after conditioning
on the selected configuration, or a fixed finite menu must pay its entire row
envelope. A simultaneous Gram confidence statement alone does not establish
that selection/deployment premise.

29 October 2026. Complementary construction within continuing Astra P1. This is
an ordinary mathematical candidate, not an independent audit or a physical
experiment. Lumpability, transport repair and Markov comparison are established
machinery; the candidate bridge is the acquired-defect receiving connection.

## 1. Actual interface and positive projection

Let (X,pi) be standard Borel with a finite noninvasive readout partition A_a,
a=1,...,k, of positive masses. Set P=E_pi[.|Y]. This P is POSITIVE, unlike a
generic signed predictive feature projection. Each actual fixed call T_j is
reversible for mu_j(dx)=w_j(Y(x))pi(dx)/pi(w_j), where the positive weights are
known and bounded. All mu_j have the same conditional hidden laws
pi_a=pi(.|A_a). Their visible equilibria and kinetics may differ.

The actual kernel/switching interface, complete microscopic reversibility,
baseline calibration preparation and known visible weights remain premises.
No hidden dimension, hidden mixing or generator bound is imposed. The theorem
only covers specified calls and endpoint records.

Write in H_j=L2(mu_j):

    R_j=(I-P)T_jP,  ||R_j||<=epsilon_j,

    c_j(a,b)=integral T_j 1_b d pi_a.

    G_j=diag(m_j),
    K_j(a,b)=<1_a,T_j1_b>_mu_j,
    D_j(b,c)=<1_b,T_j^2 1_c>_mu_j,
    D_j-K_j^T G_j^-1 K_j=<R_j1_b,R_j1_c>_mu_j.

microscopic copy is used. Independent actual calls define T_j^2. Finite data
require simultaneous confidence intervals and genuine positive mass bounds.
An empirical zero is not exact closure.
